action.waitAndRetry: Retry in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}

aborted.hint: You stopped this run — send again when you're ready.
aborted.label: Stopped

agentConfigurationMissing.hint: This agent has no command or endpoint configured yet — finish its setup in Settings.
agentConfigurationMissing.label: Agent not configured

agentDisabled.hint: This external agent is turned off — enable it in Settings, or use the built-in agent.
agentDisabled.label: Agent disabled

agentNotFound.hint: The external agent this session points at no longer exists — pick another one.
agentNotFound.label: Agent not found

agentUnavailable.hint: The external agent isn't responding — reconnect, or fall back to the built-in agent.
agentUnavailable.label: Agent unavailable

brokenPipe.hint: The connection closed unexpectedly — retry the request.
brokenPipe.label: Broken pipe

budgetExhausted.hint: This run hit its token budget — raise the limit in Settings to let it continue.
budgetExhausted.label: Budget exhausted

capabilityUnsatisfied.hint: The selected runtime doesn't support something this turn needs — nothing was sent.
capabilityUnsatisfied.label: Capability not available

chunkLoad.hint: A newer version of Cognia is available — reload to fetch the latest files.
chunkLoad.label: Outdated app version

connectionRefused.hint: The server isn't accepting connections — check it's running and the port is right.
connectionRefused.label: Connection refused

connectionReset.hint: The connection dropped mid-request — retry; if it persists, check the network or server.
connectionReset.label: Connection reset

contentPolicy.hint: The provider's safety filter blocked this — retrying the same text won't help; rephrase it.
contentPolicy.label: Blocked by content policy

contextWindowExceeded.hint: The conversation is longer than this model can read — compact it, shorten the input, or pick a model with a bigger context window.
contextWindowExceeded.label: Context window exceeded

dbUnavailable.hint: Cognia couldn't open its local database — reload; if it keeps failing, export a crash log.
dbUnavailable.label: Database unavailable

dbUpgradeBlocked.hint: Another window or tab is holding the old database version open — close it, then reload.
dbUpgradeBlocked.label: Database upgrade blocked

deadlineExceeded.hint: The operation ran past its deadline — retry, or raise the limit.
deadlineExceeded.label: Deadline exceeded

degradedFallback.hint: This turn ran on a fallback path instead of the runtime you configured.
degradedFallback.label: Ran in degraded mode

desktopOnlyFeature.hint: This feature needs the desktop app — it isn't available in the browser.
desktopOnlyFeature.label: Desktop only

dispatchFailed.hint: The request couldn't be dispatched — retry; check the agent or provider configuration.
dispatchFailed.label: Dispatch failed

dispatchRejectedCycle.hint: A subagent tried to call back into one that already called it — break the loop in the subagent setup.
dispatchRejectedCycle.label: Subagent loop rejected

dispatchRejectedDepth.hint: Subagents nested deeper than the configured limit — flatten the chain or raise the cap.
dispatchRejectedDepth.label: Nesting limit reached

dispatchRejectedPolicy.hint: The current agent mode forbids this dispatch — adjust the mode's permissions.
dispatchRejectedPolicy.label: Blocked by policy

dnsFailure.hint: The host name couldn't be resolved — check the URL and your network/DNS.
dnsFailure.label: DNS lookup failed

documentedOnly.hint: Cognia can't drive this agent directly — follow its own product workflow, or use the built-in agent.
documentedOnly.label: Documentation only

eventChannelLost.hint: Cognia stopped receiving updates from the desktop backend, so parts of the app will look frozen — reload to reconnect.
eventChannelLost.label: Live updates disconnected

executionFailed.hint: The external agent failed while running this turn — retry, or run it on the built-in agent.
executionFailed.label: Agent run failed

extensionUnknown.hint: Cognia hasn't determined whether this agent supports that operation yet — reconnect to probe it.
extensionUnknown.label: Support not determined

extensionUnsupported.hint: This agent doesn't implement that operation — start a new session instead of resuming.
extensionUnsupported.label: Not supported by this agent

externalAgentNotSelected.hint: No external agent is selected for this session — pick one, or switch back to the built-in agent.
externalAgentNotSelected.label: No agent selected

fallbackToBuiltin.hint: The external agent couldn't take this turn, so it ran on the built-in agent instead.
fallbackToBuiltin.label: Ran on the built-in agent

fetchFailed.hint: The request couldn't be sent — check your connection and the endpoint URL.
fetchFailed.label: Network request failed

forbidden.hint: Your account lacks access to this resource or model.
forbidden.label: Forbidden

frozenModelBinding.hint: This session is pinned to a fixed set of models and the requested one isn't among them.
frozenModelBinding.label: Model not allowed here

healthCheckFailed.hint: The agent started but failed its health check — check its logs, then reconnect.
healthCheckFailed.label: Health check failed

healthProbeFailed.hint: Cognia couldn't reach the paired device — check that both are on the same network.
healthProbeFailed.label: Device unreachable

hostUnavailable.hint: The remote host that should run this turn isn't reachable — retry, or check its configuration.
hostUnavailable.label: Remote host unavailable

initializationFailed.hint: The agent process started but never completed its handshake — check its command and arguments.
initializationFailed.label: Agent failed to start

interrupted.hint: The run was interrupted before it finished — send again to continue.
interrupted.label: Interrupted

invalidRequest.hint: The request was malformed — check the parameters and model name.
invalidRequest.label: Invalid request

modelOverloaded.hint: The provider is overloaded — retry in a moment.
modelOverloaded.label: Model overloaded

modelRequired.hint: Select a model for this provider before sending.
modelRequired.label: Model not set

networkUnreachable.hint: The host can't be reached — check your connection and any proxy or VPN.
networkUnreachable.label: Network unreachable

noSessionOpen.hint: There's no open conversation to send to — start a new one.
noSessionOpen.label: No conversation open

notFound.hint: The resource or endpoint doesn't exist — check the URL or id.
notFound.label: Not found

offline.hint: You appear to be offline — Cognia will retry once you're back online.
offline.label: Offline

payloadTooLarge.hint: The request exceeds the size limit — shorten the input.
payloadTooLarge.label: Request too large

permissionDenied.hint: The agent refused an action it wasn't allowed to take — adjust its permission mode.
permissionDenied.label: Permission denied

pluginToolMissing.hint: The requested tool isn't available — enable the plugin that provides it.
pluginToolMissing.label: Tool unavailable

prerequisiteMissing.hint: The command this agent needs isn't installed or isn't on your PATH — install it, or point Cognia at an existing copy.
prerequisiteMissing.label: Missing prerequisite

promptBlockedByPlugin.hint: A plugin stopped this message before it was sent — check the plugin's settings.
promptBlockedByPlugin.label: Blocked by a plugin

protocolUnsupported.hint: Cognia and this agent don't share a protocol — switch it to ACP and save its configuration again.
protocolUnsupported.label: Protocol not supported

providerMisconfigured.hint: This provider needs more setup — set the protocol and credentials in Settings.
providerMisconfigured.label: Provider misconfigured

proxyApplyFailed.hint: Cognia couldn't apply your proxy settings, so outgoing requests may be bypassing it.
proxyApplyFailed.label: Proxy not applied

quotaExceeded.hint: Your plan's quota is used up — check billing or usage limits.
quotaExceeded.label: Quota exceeded

rateLimited.hint: You hit a rate limit — wait a moment and retry.
rateLimited.label: Rate limited

renderCrash.hint: Part of the interface crashed — try again; if it keeps happening, send us the report.
renderCrash.label: Application error

routingNoCandidates.hint: No provider in the routing chain can serve this request — check your providers and model mappings.
routingNoCandidates.label: No provider available

seedFailed.hint: Cognia couldn't install its built-in skills and characters — some defaults will be missing.
seedFailed.label: Built-in content missing

serverError.hint: The server failed to handle the request — retry shortly.
serverError.label: Server error

serviceUnavailable.hint: The service is temporarily unavailable — retry shortly.
serviceUnavailable.label: Service unavailable

sessionResolutionFailed.hint: The agent couldn't resume this conversation — start a new session.
sessionResolutionFailed.label: Session couldn't be resumed

sessionTimeout.hint: The model didn't respond in time — retry, or check the sidecar and connection.
sessionTimeout.label: Session timed out

settingsLoadFailed.hint: Cognia couldn't read your saved settings and is running on defaults — your data is still stored, but nothing you configured is active.
settingsLoadFailed.label: Settings didn't load

settingsSaveFailed.hint: That change wasn't saved — retry; if it keeps failing, check the logs.
settingsSaveFailed.label: Settings didn't save

sidecarExited.hint: The Claude sidecar exited mid-run — retry; if it recurs, restart the app.
sidecarExited.label: Backend stopped

sidecarUnreachable.hint: The local agent backend isn't running — restart it to send messages again.
sidecarUnreachable.label: Backend not running

strictFailure.hint: The external agent failed and this session is set to strict mode, so nothing was retried elsewhere.
strictFailure.label: Agent failed (strict mode)

supervisorMissing.hint: This team is set up to use a supervisor but none is configured — pick one in the team's settings.
supervisorMissing.label: No supervisor configured

supervisorNotMember.hint: The configured supervisor isn't a member of this team any more — pick another one.
supervisorNotMember.label: Supervisor not on the team

teamMissing.hint: The team this conversation belongs to has been deleted — pick another team, or start a new conversation.
teamMissing.label: Team no longer exists

teamSessionMissing.hint: This team conversation couldn't be found — it may have been deleted.
teamSessionMissing.label: Team conversation not found

timeout.hint: The request took too long — retry, or raise the timeout.
timeout.label: Request timed out

transportBlocked.hint: Running an external agent needs the desktop app — in the browser, use the built-in agent.
transportBlocked.label: Needs the desktop app

unauthorized.hint: Authentication failed — check your API key or token in Settings.
unauthorized.label: Unauthorized

unknown.hint: Something went wrong that Cognia doesn't recognise — the details below help us diagnose it.
unknown.label: Unexpected error

recoveryHint.checkCommandAndArgs: Check the agent's command and startup arguments.
recoveryHint.checkDiagnosticsAndRetry: Check the run diagnostics, then retry with a narrower request.
recoveryHint.completeSetupThenRetry: Finish this agent's setup, then retry the connection.

recoveryHint.inspectHealthEndpoint: Check the agent's health endpoint and logs.
recoveryHint.resumeWithSessionIdOrAllowNew: Resume with an existing session id, or allow a new session to be created.
recoveryHint.selectLocalSurface: Pick a locally executable surface to connect to directly.
recoveryHint.switchToAcp: Switch the agent's protocol to ACP.
recoveryHint.useDesktopRuntime: Run Cognia as the desktop app — stdio transport needs it.
recoveryHint.useOfficialWorkflow: Use this product's own official workflow for this surface.
recoveryHint.useSupportedOperations: Stick to the operations this endpoint supports.

dbUpgradeBlocked.body: Cognia needs to upgrade its local database, but another window or browser tab still has the old version open. Close the other windows, then reload.
dbUpgradeBlocked.title: Database upgrade blocked

settingsLoadFailed.body: Cognia couldn't read your saved settings and is running on defaults for now. Your providers, API keys and preferences are still stored — they just aren't loaded. Retry before changing anything.
settingsLoadFailed.title: Running on default settings
